name: Cannon River (Cannon Falls–Red Wing)

gaugeContext.note: The Welch gauge provides reference flow for the lower Cannon. Lake Byllesby operations and tributaries can change local conditions. No travel-speed calibration is assigned.

timing.note: No reviewed flow-to-speed model or matching numeric trip-time range is assigned.

sections.difficulty: Moderate current; shallow riffles in low water
sections.notes: A shorter Cannon Falls outing ending at Sunset Trail, upstream of the closed Miesville access. Arrange your shuttle.

notices.title: Miesville access closed for construction
notices.text: The agency inventory says Miesville Ravine has no river-shoreline access during 2026 construction. Do not plan a landing there; confirm reopening with the park.
